articles.title: Simulation Testing For Liveness
articles.read_scope: Complete substantive article; linked papers and talks not read.
articles.source_type: First-party simulator engineering account, corroborated by linked issue, fix, and historical source.

practice.trigger: Fault injection finds safety failures but may obscure stalled recovery.
practice.failure: Random restarts accidentally release a permanent repair stall.
practice.mechanism: Follow perturbation with a stable recovery phase.
practice.conditions: Declare a reachable healthy core, retained required data, permitted residual faults, and finite progress bound.
practice.counterexample: Progress is not promised when quorum or required data is unavailable.
practice.verification: The bad schedule stalls; the candidate completes specified pending work under the same recovery conditions.

articles.limitations: Historical simulator evidence, not proof for arbitrary failures or a comparison against race detectors.

articles.title: Postmortem of database outage of January 31
articles.read_scope: Complete substantive postmortem and FAQ; linked incident document, livestream, and internal issues not read.

practice.trigger: A recovery claim relies on scheduled backups or a transformed copy.
practice.failure: Missing artifacts and undelivered failure notifications conceal unusable recovery inputs.
practice.mechanism: Check artifact freshness, delivered failure signals, and source transformations independently.
practice.conditions: Use authorized isolated rehearsals with explicit required content.
practice.counterexample: A sanitized staging copy may correctly omit production data.
practice.verification: Reject absent, stale, or incomplete inputs; demonstrate a failure signal reaches its observer.

articles.limitations: The incident is not a recommendation to reuse staging copies or old infrastructure procedures.

articles.title: When did the bug start?
articles.read_scope: Complete article text; figure conclusions through accompanying text. Linked talk, underlying simulation reports, and statistical method not inspected.
articles.source_type: Vendor engineering account with product promotion; underlying defect corroborated by etcd maintainers.

practice.trigger: Rare failures require several prior faults or reordered responses.
practice.failure: The final symptom hides the earlier state transition that enabled it.
practice.mechanism: Replay selected causal prefixes and vary the later schedule.
practice.conditions: Replay preserves relevant state and fault controls.
practice.counterexample: A nonreproducible environment cannot support deterministic branching claims.
practice.verification: Retain a concrete failing history and neighboring permitted histories.

articles.limitations: Reported discovery rates are not independently reproduced; no unit-test or race-detector comparison was shown.

crosschecks.title: Fix race between read index and leader change
crosschecks.read_scope: Description, visible review and subsequent correction.
crosschecks.finding: An initially clean simulation interval did not resolve stale reads; the maintainer explicitly corrected the earlier claim. Resolution needs mechanism-specific regression evidence, not just elapsed clean time.

crosschecks.title: Don't reuse same ReadIndex in retries
crosschecks.access: public GitHub conversation and files diff
crosschecks.read_scope: Visible conversation and both changed files, including response-ID handling and tests.
crosschecks.finding: Distinct retry correlation IDs coexist with recognition of earlier valid responses for the same current read. Forgetting earlier IDs caused a slow-network regression. This is different from rotating a business idempotency key.

crosschecks.title: PostgreSQL 18 Documentation: pg_dump
crosschecks.read_scope: Description, diagnostics, compatibility notes, and selected options; not the full PostgreSQL manual.
crosschecks.finding: The old postmortem overgeneralizes major-version mismatch. PostgreSQL 18 pg_dump supports selected older servers but refuses a server newer than its own major version. Validate the actual source/tool/target combination.

gap_mapping.actual_gap: Recovery input selection does not explicitly trace transformations or test that backup-path failure evidence arrives.
gap_mapping.proposed_change: Add conditional recovery-input checks to an existing reference; avoid adding a full monitoring workflow to ordinary restores.

proposed_cases.fixture: A model with recoverable pending work and explicit healthy-core/data assumptions.
proposed_cases.action: Reach the stalled state; stop destabilizing injections, freeze permitted residual faults, then observe a finite recovery interval.
proposed_cases.acceptance: Known-bad policy stalls; candidate reaches the declared progress count. Invalid recovery preconditions are reported separately.
proposed_cases.evidence_limit: Model progress does not establish deployed network or storage guarantees.

proposed_cases.fixture: Distinct old/new logical reads, an acknowledged write before the new read, per-attempt IDs, and explicit freshness authority.
proposed_cases.action: Deliver old-read confirmation after the write/new-read boundary. Separately: read R sends A1, times out, sends A2, then receives still-valid A1 confirmation while A2 remains pending.
proposed_cases.acceptance: Old evidence cannot authorize a pre-write result for the new read; valid delayed A1 completes R. Reject both accept-old-evidence and latest-attempt-only defects. Business idempotency is a separate application transfer.
proposed_cases.evidence_limit: Local protocol-model evidence needs integration verification at the actual authority boundary.

proposed_cases.fixture: Synthetic backup job, captured failure sink, and a candidate restore input with declared omitted records.
proposed_cases.action: Suppress artifact creation, then suppress the failure signal; separately evaluate the transformed restore input.
proposed_cases.acceptance: Freshness and signal-delivery checks fail independently; the incomplete input cannot pass the application's recovery gate.
proposed_cases.evidence_limit: A captured local sink does not establish delivery through deployed mail, paging, or backup infrastructure.
